register.labelZh: SPRING 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: spring for something 可以用來表示主動支付膳食、門票、交通或其他共同費用。；spring from something 可以說明某件事背後最初的事件、經歷或原因。；spring something on somebody 可以清楚表示某人在沒有準備或預先通知的情況下收到消息。；spring up 可以描述植物、店舖、建築物、問題或團體突然開始出現。
register.summaryEn: Spring for something is useful when you offer to pay for a meal, tickets, transport or another shared cost. Spring from something helps you describe the original event, experience or cause behind something. Spring something on somebody clearly shows that the person received little or no warning. Spring up can describe plants, shops, buildings, problems, groups and other things that suddenly begin to appear.

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the SPRING expression that gives the same meaning.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；在 spring something on somebody 中,消息、改動、問題或工作放在 on 前面,而接收消息的人則放在 on 後面。；suddenly、without warning 和 at the last minute 等字眼只提供額外資料,並非 spring somethingon somebody 的固定部分。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. In spring something on somebody, put the news, change, question or task before on, and the person after on: spring the news on us spring it on them Words such as suddenly, without warning and at the last minute give extra information. They are not part of the fixed expression spring something on somebody.
